name: v5.1.0
body:
### Features

- **theme:** Support custom themes in settings.yaml ([#181](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/181)) ([a840e49](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/a840e492fe342663704bb5ea2f22970eb08c4211))

### Performance

- **deserializers:** Cache local Avro schemas and Confluent Protobuf deserializers ([#178](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/178)) ([623d8b4](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/623d8b428a085260cf8a08c20d2263b0143190fc))
- **consumer:** Deserialize each polled batch in one executor call ([#179](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/179)) ([f9af423](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/f9af42316702b58eea5a9e788b1d0feea4188db8))

### Documentation

- **agent:** Load agent instructions in Claude Code and add guide contents ([#180](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/180)) ([0e0eee0](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/0e0eee04aa725cf9381c43dc2278dcf2103f1073))


**Full Changelog:** [v5.0.2...v5.1.0](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/compare/v5.0.2...v5.1.0)
